ml-primer.title: Foundations of Machine Learning and Statistical Learning Theory
requiredFacts: Machine learning focuses on algorithms that iteratively improve performance through empirical data
Statistical learning minimizes empirical risk because true joint probability is unknown
Parametric models have a fixed parameter capacity while non-parametric models scale with data volume
Supervised learning uses labeled pairs while unsupervised learning operates without target labels
Deep neural networks use multiple hidden layers and non-linear activation functions
Overfitting occurs when a model memorizes noise instead of generalizable patterns
Mitigation techniques include L1/L2 regularization, dropout, early stopping, and cross-validation
Retrieval-Augmented Generation combines semantic vector retrieval with generative language models
forbiddenFacts: Machine learning models always guarantee zero error on training data
Contexta requires Quantum Computers to train neural networks
Supervised learning never requires ground-truth target labels

privacy-security-policy.title: Contexta Privacy Policy and Security Architecture
requiredFacts: Contexta stores original documents in private object storage using UUID keys
Chunks and 768-dimensional embeddings are stored in PostgreSQL using pgvector
User-provided LLM API keys are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM
Plaintext keys are never written to disk or logged
Document deletion initiates a cascading delete of all chunks, embeddings, and summaries
Account termination permanently purges all user data within 60 seconds without shadow copies
Under the free tier, submitted content may be processed by Google to improve its models
Users can revoke privacy consent at any time, which blocks further uploads
forbiddenFacts: Contexta sells user data and prompts to third-party advertising networks
BYOK keys are stored in unencrypted plaintext inside relational tables
Deleted documents are permanently archived in public repositories

operations-manual.title: Contexta Operations and Reliability Runbook
requiredFacts: Next.js frontend runs on Vercel and Express API runs on Render free instances
Render free tier sleeps after 15 minutes of inactivity resulting in 30-50 second cold starts
All services validate environment variables at startup using Zod schemas
KEY_ENCRYPTION_SECRET must be 32 bytes encoded in 64 hex or 44 base64 characters
Jobs table coordinates background ingestion using SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
Transient errors retry with exponential backoff up to maximum attempts
Fatal errors like scanned PDFs fail immediately without wasting retries
Watchdog reclaims stale processing jobs abandoned for over 5 minutes
forbiddenFacts: Contexta uses Kubernetes clusters with auto-scaling GPUs on AWS
The health check endpoint returns 404 when database is operational
Stale jobs are permanently deleted after 10 seconds of inactivity

product-specification.title: Contexta Product and Engineering Specification
requiredFacts: Verified users receive a baseline free allowance of 50,000 tokens
Supported file formats are PDF, DOCX, and plain text TXT
Maximum file size is 10 Megabytes and maximum page count is 100 pages
Scanned PDFs with fewer than 50 characters across 5+ pages are rejected with an OCR required message
Chunks are sized to approximately 600 tokens with 80 token overlap
Retrieval uses gemini-embedding-001 at 768 dimensions with HNSW indexing
Hybrid search combines vector search and full-text keyword search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion
Chat responses stream via SSE with delta, sources, usage, and done events
forbiddenFacts: Contexta supports video, audio, and executable binary uploads in v1
Free-tier users are granted unlimited tokens with no daily server cap
Retrieval requires sending the entire 100-page document to the LLM on every turn
